intro.en: The list below is every row of the Electoral Commission spreadsheet Electorate Candidates 2026. The 9 October 2026 release links that file. On {date} the live file address returned a challenge page, so the copy read that day is the Internet Archive capture of the same address dated 16 October 2026. The workbook’s created time is 9 October 2026. Each row is one electorate candidate and the party, or Independent, printed in the file. The file has 71 electorates and 469 candidates. The Commission’s 2026 media kit says there are 64 general electorates and seven Māori electorates. The seven Māori electorates named on the Commission’s electorate-maps page follow the general electorates below. A profile link is an English Wikipedia introduction read on {date} that identified that person as a New Zealand politician of the same party, or as a leader of that party. Names without that match are not linked. This page does not say which name to mark. Source: {source}.

orderNote.en: Within each electorate the names stay in the order of that spreadsheet. That order is alphabetical by surname, with Mc sorted as Mac. The Candidate Handbook says electorate candidate names appear alphabetically by surname on the ballot paper.
